findings.name: Uncalibrated linear transition timing
findings.evidence: Uncalibrated linear transition detected: "transition: "all 0.3s ease"". Lacks calibrated spring physics.
findings.repairInstruction: Replace linear ease with Framer Motion spring preset: { type: 'spring', stiffness: 320, damping: 28, mass: 0.8 } from craft_dna.json.

findings.name: Placeholder copy in finished product
findings.repairInstruction: Replace generic placeholder text with authentic, domain-specific terminology matching the product brief.

findings.name: Raw styling bypasses design tokens
findings.evidence: Component has 1 raw hex styling override(s) (bg-[#3b82f6]), bypassing semantic theme tokens.
findings.repairInstruction: Refactor raw hex colors to semantic theme variables (e.g. bg-background, text-foreground, border-border, bg-primary) or Astryx/StyleX theme tokens.

findings.name: Required accessibility gate fails
findings.evidence: Image element missing required alt attribute for accessibility.
findings.repairInstruction: Add a descriptive alt attribute, or alt='' with aria-hidden='true' if decorative.

findings.name: Required accessibility gate fails
findings.evidence: Found 'outline: none' or 'outline-none' without a designated :focus-visible focus ring indicator. Traps keyboard navigators.
findings.repairInstruction: Preserve browser focus rings or provide an explicit focus-visible ring: 'focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary focus-visible:outline-none'.

findings.name: Required accessibility gate fails
findings.evidence: Interactive button target size appears below 44x44px WCAG touch target guideline.
findings.repairInstruction: Ensure all interactive click/tap targets maintain at least 44x44px hit bounds (e.g. min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] or ample padding).
